product_name: Lava Blaze AMOLED 2 5G (Sparkling Black, 6 GB RAM, 128 GB Storage) | 6.67" FHD+ AMOLED Display | MTK D7060 Processor | 50 MP Front Camera | LPDDR5 UFS 3.1 ROM | 5000 mAh | 33W Fast Charging
description: Blazing Performance: Experience blazing-fast 5G with the segment’s first 2.6GHz octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7060 (6nm) chipset - built for speed, smooth multitasking with an impressive AnTuTu score of 500K. Equipped with 6GB LPDDR5 RAM and 128GB UFS 3.1 storage for lightning-fast app launches and seamless data access. RAM is expandable up to 12GB (6GB physical + 6GB virtual) to ensure smoother performance during heavy multitasking. Immersive AMOLED Experience: Enjoy stunning visuals on a 6.67" FHD+ 2.5D AMOLED Punch-Hole Display with a super-smooth 120Hz refresh rate. With support for Widevine L1, 10-bit color depth (1.07 billion colors) and up to 1000+ nits brightness (APL), every scroll, video, and game feels ultra-fluid, vibrant, and true-to-life. 50MP AI Camera with Sony Sensor: Capture every moment in crystal clarity with the 50MP AI rear camera powered by the IMX752 Sony sensor. From vibrant daylight shots to low-light scenes, enjoy sharp, detailed, and lifelike photos with enhanced AI modes like HDR, Portrait, Beauty, Dual-View Video, and more. Slim, Stylish & Sound-Packed: With segment's slimmest 7.55mm body, the Lava Blaze AMOLED 2 combines lightweight comfort with a premium Feather White or Midnight Black finish that looks as elegant as it feels. Whether you’re scrolling, gaming, or streaming, enjoy immersive stereo sound that elevates your experience. Stay powered all day with a 5000mAh battery and get back to 50% in under 35 minutes with 33W Type-C Fast Charging. Clean Android 15 OS with Seamless Unlocking: Experience the latest Android 15 in its purest form - no bloatware, no ads, no clutter. Paired with In-Display Fingerprint Sensor and Face Unlock, enjoy a fast, secure, and effortlessly smooth smartphone experience.
